clinicsay.line: Healthcare SaaS: billing, scheduling and documents across React 19 and a hexagonal Fastify API.
highlights: Billing: invoices, receipts, credit notes, partial payments, refunds, cash sessions with reconciliation, and configurable numbering.
Scheduling: availability templates with exceptions, one appointments API with recurring series, and a drag-and-touch calendar with optimistic updates.
Documents: PDFs rebuilt on react-pdf, bilingual invoices and quotes through an OpenAI translation endpoint, and accounting exports to Excel.
Domain events: handlers on a transactional outbox, such as recalculating what a patient owes after any related change.
PostgreSQL performance on search, list and calendar queries, and virus scanning of uploaded files.

rules.title: Boundaries are explicit.
rules.text: Dependency runs one way — interface to application, application to domain. The domain knows nothing of the framework, the database or the transport. A boundary is crossed by a written decision.

rules.title: The smallest change that works.
rules.text: No abstraction for a future that has not arrived; whatever stops being used goes in the same change.

rules.title: Verify before claiming.
rules.text: Nothing is done because it compiles. It is done when the gates pass and it has been seen in the production build.

rules.title: Decisions are written down.
rules.text: What cannot be read off the code goes into a dated record with at least two options compared.

meta.title: brunogalvan.dev — Case study — Bruno Galván
meta.description: The site itself: a static Astro build in two languages, a Content Security Policy built from hashes, and Playwright with axe on every page in both themes.

headline: The site you are reading.
Every claim with a source.
brunogalvan-dev.summary: A static Astro site in two languages, where every figure is computed from a typed record and every page is tested in a real browser.
brunogalvan-dev.context: My portfolio, rebuilt in September 2026 in the grammar of one design master. It ships as static HTML with one bundled script for motion; every visible string lives in a Spanish and an English catalog, and every number is derived from the record when the site builds.

layers.name: Record
layers.text: src/data holds the roles, projects and stack; years, counts and the career chart are computed from it at build time.

layers.name: Routes
layers.text: Localized URLs live as pairs in one file, so every page exists in both languages with reciprocal hreflang.

layers.name: Tokens
layers.text: Colours and faces come from semantic tokens with a light and a dark value; a dark band re-resolves them by switching the colour scheme.

layers.name: Motion
layers.text: GSAP and Lenis run in one context that reverts completely under reduced motion or the pause control.

decisions.title: No framework in the browser
decisions.text: Static output; the only script is the motion bundle, and every page works without JavaScript.

decisions.title: A policy built from hashes
decisions.text: The build hashes every inline script and style into the Content Security Policy, so an edited block can never ship with a stale hash.

decisions.title: Tested as shipped
decisions.text: Playwright runs the production build with axe in both themes and replays the policy on every page.

decisions.title: Decisions on record
decisions.text: Hosting, the motion library and smooth scrolling each have an ADR with the options compared and the cost in kilobytes.
